{{Quote|Durasteel's all well and good, but keeping your guts on the inside is a job for Mandalorian iron.|Braum "Zakkeg" Bourne|audio=BraumBourne-JobForMandalorianIron-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Braum Bourne''', also known as '''"Zakkeg"''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Having been sent their way by [[Rally Master]] [[Merrk Kelborn]] on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], he and [[Gen Vizla]] helped give tips to the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], becoming very impressed with the young bounty hunter.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Before the mission's removal from the game, Braum "Zakkeg" Bourne appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Advanced Training mission for the Bounty Hunter class, wherein players were sent to him and [[Gen Vizla]] by [[Rally Master]] [[Merrk Kelborn]] in order to receive advice on whether to learn the skills of either a [[Powertech]] or a [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]]. While Vizla preferred the Mercenary specialization, Bourne advocated for the Powertech specialization. He could be found both on Vaiken Spacedock and in the [[Mandalorian enclave]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR" />
